data.description: ### 1. Technical Environment * **Model ID:** claude-sonnet-4-6 * **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso-dev v1.16.11 * **Active Configs:** enforcement.strategy=ci * **Context Scope:** worktree-20260506-141557, sprint epic 68f2-f403 * **code_version:** 39ec5f99a4ed27a755da1b4b036b4a5551f2fa41 ### 2. Incident Overview * **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior #### Expected Behavior Per CLAUDE.md Critical Rule 20 and memory `feedback_completion_verifier_must_use_named_agent.md`: the sprint orchestrator MUST dispatch `dso:completion-verifier` as a named sub-agent type (or read `agents/completion-verifier.md` verbatim and use `subagent_type: "general-purpose"` only when the named type is unavailable — the agent file content must be present in the prompt). Inline verification or generic-prompt substitution is explicitly prohibited. The CLAUDE.md agent routing table lists `dso:completion-verifier` with model `sonnet` as the named agent for story closure and epic closure in `/dso:sprint`. #### Actual Behavior During sprint epic 68f2-f403, the orchestrator dispatched story completion verification (stories 1df2-5125 and f629-4fa9) using `subagent_type: "general-purpose"` with a prompt that said "read `plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md` and follow its instructions." The named `dso:completion-verifier` subagent_type was not used, and the agents/completion-verifier.md file content was not loaded verbatim into the prompt — only a reference to it was included. ### 3. Action History and Workarounds * **Steps Taken:**   * Orchestrator dispatched `Agent(subagent_type="general-purpose", model="sonnet", prompt="...read agents/completion-verifier.md...")`   * Agent read the file and performed verification correctly, but via an ad-hoc general-purpose dispatch * **Known Workarounds:** None — the general-purpose agent produced correct output this session, but the rule exists to prevent impartial-review drift over time. ### 5. Skills and Workflows * **Active Workflow:** `/dso:sprint` Phase 7 (story closure Step 10a) * **Skills Invoked:** dso:completion-verifier (incorrectly dispatched as general-purpose)
data.title: /dso:sprint: dispatch completion-verifier as general-purpose subagent_type -> named dso:completion-verifier agent not used
